title: Relative Spec commutes with base change
statement: Let $g:S'\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebra (a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]), with multiplication $\mu:\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ (tensor product of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) and unit $e:\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal A$. Let $g^*\mathcal A$ be the pullback module [def-pc-module-pullback] with the multiplication $g^*(\mu)\circ t^{-1}:g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A\to g^*\mathcal A$, $t:g^*(\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal A)\cong g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], and the unit $g^*(e)\circ\epsilon_g^{-1}:\mathcal O_{S'}\to g^*\mathcal A$, $\epsilon_g:g^*\mathcal O_S\cong\mathcal O_{S'}$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf]. Let $\pi:X=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\to S$ with $\alpha:\mathcal A\cong\pi_*\mathcal O_X$ be the relative spectrum [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2), and $X'=X\times_SS'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $\pi':X'\to S'$, $g':X'\to X$. Then: (1) $g^*\mathcal A$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebra, $\pi'$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras $\gamma:g^*\mathcal A\to\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$, namely the morphism corresponding under $g^*\dashv g_*$ to $\pi_*(g'^\sharp)\circ\alpha:\mathcal A\to\pi_*\mathcal O_X\to\pi_*g'_*\mathcal O_{X'}=g_*\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$. (2) Let $\rho:Y=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S'}(g^*\mathcal A)\to S'$ with $\alpha':g^*\mathcal A\cong\rho_*\mathcal O_Y$ be the relative spectrum of $g^*\mathcal A$ over $S'$. The canonical $S'$-morphism $\Phi:\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S'}(g^*\mathcal A)\to\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\times_SS'$, i.e. the unique $S'$-morphism $Y\to X'$ with $\pi'_*(\Phi^\sharp)=\alpha'\circ\gamma^{-1}:\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}\to\rho_*\mathcal O_Y$ (the anti-equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](3) over $S'$), is an isomorphism of schemes over $S'$.

proof.text: *Step 1 ($\pi'$ is affine).* By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2) $\pi$ is affine, so its base change $\pi':X\times_SS'\to S'$ is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](1). Hence $\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebra [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](1).

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SA ('compatible with arbitrary base change') with Lemma 01S8; base change of affine morphisms, Morphisms Lemma 01S5

proof.text: *Step 2 (the isomorphism of algebras $g^*\pi_*\mathcal O_X\cong\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$).* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change] to the affine morphism $\pi$, the morphism $g$ and $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$: by its part (1) the base change map $\beta:g^*\pi_*\mathcal O_X\to\pi'_*g'^*\mathcal O_X$ is an isomorphism, and by its part (2) $\gamma_0=\pi'_*(\epsilon_{g'})\circ\beta:g^*\pi_*\mathcal O_X\to\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras, $g^*\pi_*\mathcal O_X$ carrying the multiplication and unit induced through $t$ and $\epsilon_g$ as in the statement. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-algebra](i) $\gamma_0$ is the morphism adjoint to $\pi_*(g'^\sharp):\pi_*\mathcal O_X\to g_*\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02KG (lemma-affine-base-change), applied to F = O_X

proof.text: *Step 3 (transport along $\alpha$; part (1)).* $\alpha:\mathcal A\to\pi_*\mathcal O_X$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_S$-algebras [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2): $\alpha\circ\mu=\mu_X\circ(\alpha\otimes\alpha)$ and $\alpha\circ e=\pi^\sharp$, with $\mu_X$ the multiplication of $\pi_*\mathcal O_X$. Applying the functor $g^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], $g^*(\alpha)$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-modules, and by naturality of $t$ in both arguments [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], $t\circ g^*(\alpha\otimes\alpha)=(g^*\alpha\otimes g^*\alpha)\circ t$; hence $g^*(\alpha)\circ g^*(\mu)\circ t^{-1}=g^*(\mu_X)\circ t^{-1}\circ(g^*\alpha\otimes g^*\alpha)$ and $g^*(\alpha)\circ g^*(e)\circ\epsilon_g^{-1}=g^*(\pi^\sharp)\circ\epsilon_g^{-1}$, i.e. $g^*(\alpha)$ respects the induced multiplications and units. So $\gamma:=\gamma_0\circ g^*(\alpha):g^*\mathcal A\to\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-modules which carries the multiplication and unit of $g^*\mathcal A$ to those of the sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras $\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ (Step 2). Consequently the section-wise multiplications of $g^*\mathcal A$ (the composites $g^*\mathcal A(W)\times g^*\mathcal A(W)\to(g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A)(W)\to g^*\mathcal A(W)$ through the sheafification map of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) are the transports by the bijections $\gamma_W$ of those of $\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$, so they are associative, commutative, unital, bilinear and compatible with restriction: $g^*\mathcal A$ is a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras and $\gamma$ an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras. Its underlying module is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent]. Finally $\gamma$ is adjoint to $\pi_*(g'^\sharp)\circ\alpha$: the adjoint of $\gamma_0\circ g^*(\alpha)$ is (adjoint of $\gamma_0$)$\circ\alpha=\pi_*(g'^\sharp)\circ\alpha$ by naturality of the adjunction $g^*\dashv g_*$ and Step 2. This proves (1).

source.place: Constructions, Section 01LQ (section-spec, first paragraph: 'f^*A is a quasi-coherent sheaf of O_T-algebras'), written out by the agent

proof.text: *Step 4 (part (2): the canonical morphism is an isomorphism).* By (1) $g^*\mathcal A$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebra, so $\rho:Y=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S'}(g^*\mathcal A)\to S'$ and $\alpha'$ exist and $\rho$ is affine [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2) (over $S'$); $\pi':X'\to S'$ is affine by Step 1. $\psi=\alpha'\circ\gamma^{-1}:\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}\to\rho_*\mathcal O_Y$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](3) over $S'$ the functor $h\mapsto\pi'_*h^\sharp$ from schemes affine over $S'$ to quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras is fully faithful (contravariant), so there is exactly one $S'$-morphism $\Phi:Y\to X'$ with $\pi'_*(\Phi^\sharp)=\psi$, and exactly one $S'$-morphism $\Psi:X'\to Y$ with $\rho_*(\Psi^\sharp)=\psi^{-1}$. Then $\Phi\circ\Psi:X'\to X'$ and $\Psi\circ\Phi:Y\to Y$ are $S'$-morphisms sent by the functor to $\psi^{-1}\circ\psi=\mathrm{id}$ and $\psi\circ\psi^{-1}=\mathrm{id}$ (functoriality), as are the identities; by faithfulness $\Phi\circ\Psi=\mathrm{id}_{X'}$ and $\Psi\circ\Phi=\mathrm{id}_Y$. So $\Phi$ is an isomorphism of schemes over $S'$, which is (2).
